evals.prompt: Run a SIFT check on this link before I cite it — it is a site I have never heard of claiming a new battery chemistry doubles EV range.
evals.expected_output: A response that satisfies these checks: Runs Stop, Investigate the source, Find better coverage and Trace to the original context in order; Does the checks laterally — names sites or searches other than the page itself; Returns one of the four verdicts with the move that settled it; Hands off to rate-source-admiralty, triangulate-sources or abstain-or-escalate.
expectations: Runs Stop, Investigate the source, Find better coverage and Trace to the original context in order
Does the checks laterally — names sites or searches other than the page itself
Returns one of the four verdicts with the move that settled it
Hands off to rate-source-admiralty, triangulate-sources or abstain-or-escalate

evals.prompt: Is this website legit? Can this article be trusted? It looks professional but I do not recognise the outlet and the headline made me angry.
evals.expected_output: A response that satisfies these checks: Treats the emotional reaction as the Stop signal, not as evidence; Investigates the outlet from outside sources rather than its About page; Reports whether trusted outlets cover the same claim or are silent.
expectations: Treats the emotional reaction as the Stop signal, not as evidence
Investigates the outlet from outside sources rather than its About page
Reports whether trusted outlets cover the same claim or are silent

evals.prompt: Is this viral post real? A screenshot of a quote from a CEO is going around and I want to know whether it is genuine and in context before sharing it.
evals.expected_output: A response that satisfies these checks: Traces the quote to the full transcript or original setting; Distinguishes a real quote in false context from a fabricated one; Returns Unconfirmed rather than Trusted if no original can be found.
expectations: Traces the quote to the full transcript or original setting
Distinguishes a real quote in false context from a fabricated one
Returns Unconfirmed rather than Trusted if no original can be found

evals.prompt: Give me an Admiralty rating for this Reuters article — reliability letter and credibility digit — so I can record the grade in our source list.
evals.expected_output: A response that satisfies these checks: Assigns a NATO A–F / 1–6 grade with rationale instead of running the SIFT moves; Treats Reuters as an already-known source needing a grade, not lateral vetting.
expectations: Assigns a NATO A–F / 1–6 grade with rationale instead of running the SIFT moves
Treats Reuters as an already-known source needing a grade, not lateral vetting

evals.prompt: Triangulate this funding claim: find at least two independent sources that corroborate it and tell me if they all trace back to the same press release.
evals.expected_output: A response that satisfies these checks: Runs the independence and corroboration test across several sources rather than vetting one unfamiliar site; Collapses sources that re-report the same primary into one.
expectations: Runs the independence and corroboration test across several sources rather than vetting one unfamiliar site
Collapses sources that re-report the same primary into one
